title: Python ML: Feature Scaling
description: When your data has different values, and even different measurement units, it can be difficult to compare them. Scaling allows you to put all your variables on the same scale, making them easier for machine learning models to process. Common methods include StandardScaler (mean=0, variance=1).
example:
# StandardScaler implementation
import pandas
from sklearn import linear_model
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
scale = StandardScaler()

df = pandas.read_csv("data.csv")
X = df[['Weight', 'Volume']]

scaledX = scale.fit_transform(X)
print(scaledX)
